analysis_status: Post hoc exploratory diagnostic after core and external outcomes were exposed. No confirmatory or preregistered claim.
question: Does the tested current-posture forecast add normal-source accuracy beyond an untuned normal mean prior in the same body reference?
population: Exact current 2815 common-support windows, 91 singleton source components, 29 normal sources; no altered target support or fold assignment.
folds: The five frozen cohort outer folds; each prior fits only normal sources outside its scored fold.

controls.name: mean_pose
controls.prediction: For each future horizon, distal joint and coordinate, predict the normal-training weighted coordinate mean without a state-dependent learned term.

controls.name: mean_residual
controls.prediction: Add the normal-training weighted future-minus-prefix-anchor mean to each query prefix anchor.

weighting.hierarchy: Equal source mass, equal sequence mass within source, equal window mass within sequence, using the current singleton-component hierarchy.
weighting.objective: Equal measured coordinate mean within each leg, then equal legs within each window.
weighting.output_mean_formula: For coordinate k in leg l, a_ik = w_i * 64 / n_observed_coordinates_in_leg_i * observed_ik. mean_k = sum(a_ik * target_ik) / sum(a_ik). Use identical weights for residual targets.
weighting.scaling: The common factor 64 matches the existing ridge solver and cancels from each mean. No per-source coordinate-specific renormalization is added.
weighting.unsupported: Refuse a window with no target support in a leg or an output with no permitted normal training support. Do not impute a target.

primary_horizon: Mean error over the eight future samples, not the final time only. Four-sample results are secondary.
comparisons: Both mean controls against persistence and the frozen new ridge_posture model on identical source rows. Positive reference-minus-method difference favors the mean control.

bootstrap.interval: paired conditional percentile interval on saved source errors

checks: All128 weighted intercepts compared with an independent sklearn solver under missingness
For every outer fold, poison all held-out future values and support bits, then refit; fitted means and prefix predictions must be unchanged.
Verify frozen core inputs and leave every original result unchanged.
budget: Five very small normal-source mean fits plus paired bootstrap summaries. No neural training, hyperparameter search, data acquisition, or primary anomaly re-selection.
review_required: docs/reference_v2/mean_prior_review.json, status accepted_before_posthoc_fitting with exact declaration and script hashes.
